name: Pochi
source: [spoiler]The true protagonist of [i]World's End Club[/i], who was controlling the robot Reycho via remote control. Becomes the official protagonist once the Reycho robot is disabled. An artificial intelligence created by MAIK initially programmed to infiltrate the Go-Getter's Club, he eventually sided with his friends to stop MAIK. He is an X-TYPE able to communicate with the Otherworlder (the Player).[/spoiler]
translation: [spoiler]The true protagonist of [i]World's End Club[/i], who was controlling the robot Reycho via remote control. Becomes the official protagonist once the Reycho robot is disabled.
